g.text: Release with blockers, evidence and bounded exposure
A clean finite suite supports a scoped decision; it cannot prove consequential failures impossible.
Declare noncompensating blockers before reviewing scores
Unauthorized access/action • unsupported consequential number • omitted required approval
Review task acceptance, paired regressions, judge validity, uncertainty and total review/cost together.Excellent average utility does not offset a domain-defined blocking failure.
Scope and versions; results by slice;traces; material regressions;expert disagreements; known limitsand accepted exceptions.
Investigate or promote within scope.Inadequate evidence warrantsfurther work; authority remainsoutside automated diagnosis.
Monitor with explicit pause, rollbackand renewed-review conditions.Broaden assessment when uncertaintycould change the decision.
Proposed gate informed by banking, failure-study and Two Sigma accounts; no implemented bank threshold/rollback policy was captured.
